native_smoke.result: The application starts on both the Xwayland and Wayland platforms with no source, creates its window, and stays alive after the graph-create + viewer-attach interaction with no QML/runtime errors on stderr.
native_smoke.capture_limitation: Native pixel capture is not possible in this environment: the session runs rootless Xwayland with no compositor screenshot client, so x11grab of the X root returns a uniform black frame (verified: signalstats YMIN=YMAX=16). No Wayland screenshot tool (grim/spectacle/etc.) is installed. Per the issue's evidence rules this run is a startup/interaction non-crash check only; it is NOT appearance or interaction-parity evidence. Owner native review of the Viewer node rendering, viewer index selector, removed badge chrome, and the 1-9 attach gesture remains required.
